source: Ordinary WAsmC compile_lib_auto creates list of two records each owning one string; returns list length.
coverage: 32 normal calls, 192 injected failures across first/second list push, record-child move and string builder push, with 192 immediate successful calls in the same Store after each failure.
ledger: Intercepted successful root constructors, root drops, and transfers into parent record/list. 1824 roots created, 1152 transferred, 672 dropped at boundary, 0 unowned root handles after every call. This relies on CoreLib parent destruction to release transferred children; it is not an independent count of all internal live allocations.
limitations: Wasmtime only for injected faults; earlier normal calls independently passed Wasmi and Wasmtime. No installed external Lib fault injection, physical heap introspection, Source admission or release.
